dedupe_keys.name: ctu mobile signal measurements motorways railway corridors and stationary 2g and 4g tests czechia

description: ČTÚ publishes the results of its own field measurements of mobile signal as three datasets. Stationary measurements of 2G and 4G signal carried out by ČTÚ staff at many locations are published as ZIP packages per operator (O2, T-Mobile and Vodafone), each holding CSV and XLSX data and a JSON description of the structure, updated in September 2026, with maps on ČTÚ's vportal. Drive measurements of mobile coverage on the motorways (D0 to D5 and others), made in October and November 2016, are published as one CSV per motorway. Measurements along the four transit railway corridors (Děčín to Břeclav, Břeclav to Česká Třebová, Cheb to the Slovak border, and Děčín to Horní Dvořiště), made in April 2016, are published as one CSV per corridor with a text description. Coverage: Czechia's motorway and main rail network and stationary test points. Format and access: CSV, XLSX and ZIP files on the ČTÚ open data catalogue, free under ČTÚ terms allowing reuse with attribution. Caveats: the corridor and motorway campaigns are 2016 snapshots before 5G; measured signal depends on equipment and time. Simulation uses: validating coverage models along transport corridors, assessing connectivity gaps for train and road users during emergencies, and exposure of transport operations that rely on mobile networks. Related records: the Brno University railway corridor dataset gives newer research measurements, and the ČTÚ catalogue record lists the rest.
